record_title: Exact periodicity for the neighboring-diagonal family S_{f,2f+1}
scientific_context: A proof of the neighboring-diagonal family g=2f+1 in the strict greedy 2-sumfree periodicity conjectures of van Berkel and Bosma, with an exact membership formula, minimal periods, and density.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem covers f>=3 only for g=2f+1 and does not settle arbitrary 2-sumfree sequences or further off-diagonal strips. The motivating preprint is very recent, so contemporaneous unindexed work remains a residual originality risk. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.

artifact_inventory.description: Exact-integer checks of the residue identities, greedy closed form, and minimal period data.
